page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-144-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-heavy server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 144 vCPUs mapped to 72 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 1116 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is highly performant, consisting of 24 local NVMe SSDs providing a total capacity of 9383 GB.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, placing in the top 10% for multi-core CPU stress tests and Geekbench multi-core scores. The Intel Xeon architecture includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate cryptographic operations and matrix math. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with read-only cached small block transfers exceeding 11,500 GB/sec and uncached large block reads reaching 533.92 GB/sec. Single-core performance is moderate, aligning with the middle 50% of tested systems, indicating that workloads must be highly parallelized to leverage the hardware fully.

Given its massive local NVMe storage array and high memory capacity, the instance is highly cost-efficient for data-intensive workloads that require high resource density without the overhead of external storage. It achieves top-tier results in database operations and Redis SET benchmarks, processing over 219 million operations per second. The presence of AMX instructions also enables efficient CPU-based LLM inference, particularly for prompt processing. This server is best suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, high-throughput web serving, and parallelized data processing pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-144-lssd is a high-density, memory-optimized server configured with 144 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor and 1116 GB of RAM. Designed for data-intensive applications, it integrates 24 local NVMe SSDs totaling 9383 GB of high-speed storage. The architecture supports advanced vector and matrix extensions (AVX-512 and AMX), driving top-tier multi-core execution and memory bandwidth benchmarks. While single-core performance is moderate, its massive parallel processing capabilities and high-speed local storage make it highly efficient for demanding workloads. It is optimally suited for large-scale databases, high-throughput Redis deployments, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
